evaluation: Identical P4 labeled patches and experiments (>=4 finite labels), ceil(n/4), same stable tie rules, date equal macro; retain zero/low/outlier labels

ID_prior.training_residual: PCE_backward - observed labeled mean of SAME TRAINING experiment
ID_prior.unshrunk_reconciliation: ID_PRIOR_UNSHRUNK_DIAGNOSTIC, same formula with 0 pseudo-count; no model selection

position_encoding: 32 category one-hot, no inferred physical coordinates or distances; standardize training-only using all optical patches in training dates

pairwise.ID_only_ablation: ID_PAIRWISE, same estimator/pairs/weights as combined but only 32 ID one-hot columns
pairwise.features: 32 patchID one-hot columns + P4 12 relative optical summaries; train-only standardization on all optical patches
pairwise.relative_formula: P4 Relative unchanged: (x-experiment optical median)/max(1.4826*experiment optical MAD, max(1e-12,0.01*median(abs(training optical feature))))
pairwise.pairs_and_weights: P4 exact construction reused, all informative unordered within-experiment training pairs, symmetric orientations, date equal then experiment equal, weights mean 1
pairwise.hyperparameter_selection: NONE: one C and one categorical/PL concatenation, no searches or ensembles
pairwise.why_ID_pair_ablation: Matched-objective ID-only control is necessary to distinguish added optical information from changing empirical prior to pairwise loss; same algorithm, not a fourth model class

fixed_effect_diagnosis: For scoring ONLY, observed eval within-experiment PCE residual minus TRAINING-fit ID prior; report MSE reduction and PL score Spearman before/after ID adjustment. No evaluation target enters features, fit, normalization or prediction.
interpretation: patchID physical interpretation determined from evidence separately; category pattern alone cannot establish a spatial grid or measurement order

bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive reused-date intervals, never patch/pair significance
